task.text: Write a humorous story about Jowee from Drawn to Life getting out of bed at 3 AM to get a glass of milk, when he discovers Wilfre at his fridge, pouring himself a glass of milk. Jowee is startled by Wilfre’s abrupt appearance and asks him why he’s in his house. Wilfre tells Jowee that he simply came to Jowee’s house because he ran out of milk at his own house. Jowee is baffled by this and begins to ask more questions.
